name: NextERP Settings
description: Payments and AI for the NextERP desktop app.

fields.label: Take M-Pesa payments at the till
Business short code
fields.description: The paybill number, or for a till the store number Safaricom gave with it.

fields.label: Mode of payment
fields.description: The mode M-Pesa payments are recorded under on invoices.

fields.label: Callback token
fields.description: Part of the address Safaricom calls back; made automatically.

fields.label: AI assistant
fields.description: The assistant answers from the site's records with each user's own permissions, and drafts documents for them to check and save. It never saves or changes anything itself.

fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
Anthropic (Claude)
OpenAI
Google Gemini
Groq
OpenAI-compatible (local or other)

fields.label: Model
fields.description: For Claude, blank means claude-opus-5-5. For the others, the provider's model name (for a local server, the one it serves).

fields.label: Server address
fields.description: Its OpenAI-style address, for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Kept encrypted on the site; never sent to the app.

fields.label: Only for users with role
fields.description: Blank: every user who signs in to the app.
